hook.name: PmavHookBnb
hook.description: A bonding curve launchpad hook for BNB Smart Chain that sells tokens along an AMM curve with block+1 anti-snipe protection, per-wallet 2% permanent caps, and dynamic fees. When the curve fills, it graduates the pool to a standard Uniswap v4 AMM with a permanently locked full-range liquidity position and a flat 1% LP fee set via updateDynamicLPFee.
